label: Resolver
description: Resolves logical resource identifiers into loader definitions, URLs and resource paths.

registry.description: A frozen snapshot of resolver rule metadata, excluding mutable regular expressions.

has.description: Returns whether a resource identifier matches an allowed resolver rule, ignoring its query string and fragment.

returns.description: True when a matching rule exists and any captured name/path passes validation.

resolve.description: Resolves a logical resource identifier to its matching definition, absolute URL and resource path. Returns null if no rule matches.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Logical resource identifier; query string and fragment are ignored.

returns.description: An object { definition, url, path } on success or null on failure. The path is null when the definition source is an absolute URL.
